About Rank List IQ

MissionMed Institute

Rank List IQ helps residency applicants structure priorities, score programs consistently, and build a defensible rank strategy.

Product: Rank List IQ
Version: v0.9 beta
Publisher: MissionMed Institute

Decision support tool; apply your own constraints.

Rank Priorities

Rank Priorities allow you to apply structured preferences that override scoring when needed.

Use this when:

  • You want one specialty to always rank above another.
  • You want programs grouped by preference strength.
  • You want scoring within groups — but not across groups.

How it works:

  1. Assign programs to Tier A, B, or C. Tier A programs always rank above Tier B, regardless of score. Tier B always ranks above Tier C.
  2. Within each tier, programs are sorted by score.
  3. You can also Pin a program to Top (always first) or Bottom (always last).

Example:

If you interviewed in both Internal Medicine and Family Medicine, and you want all Internal Medicine programs to rank above Family Medicine regardless of score:

→ Assign Internal Medicine programs to Tier A

→ Assign Family Medicine programs to Tier B
The system will enforce that rule automatically.
